title: Hostile Neural Networks & Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
description: Adds extra data models to Hostile Neural Networks with support for a  Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
body:
this data pack was created for my build 

this data package adds data models for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks  

It allows you to get 8 pieces of magic essence , 2 pieces of magic ink and 1 piece of runes corresponding to the magician from predictions.


 As well as the loot of an ancient knight, 4 "netherite scrap" and "ash essence", as well as 12 pieces of gold or iron.
